Deluxe Veranda Suite with large private veranda, full butler service, Lavazza espresso machine, and Regent's most comprehensive all-inclusive package — truly nothing is extra.

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Seven Seas Explorer — named 'The Most Luxurious Ship Ever Built' — departs on a 12-night all-inclusive Alaska voyage. All excursions, dining, beverages, and gratuities are included.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A refined day at sea aboard the most luxurious ship afloat. Butler service, all-suite accommodations, and Regent's all-inclusive hospitality set the tone immediately.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Coastal Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Extended time in Alaska's capital with all shore excursions included — helicopter glacier tours, whale watching, and city exploration are all at no additional charge for Regent guests.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway is an included excursion for Regent guests — simply reserve your preferred time. Enjoy the dramatic mountain scenery without the stress of excursion booking.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through Glacier Bay plus optional included zodiac tours to the glacier face — an experience unavailable on larger ships. Regent's expedition team guides the experience.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Extended time in Sitka with all excursions included. A private guide through Sitka National Historical Park, kayaking among sea otters, or a raptor center visit — all included in your fare.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: A leisurely sea day as Seven Seas Explorer glides through the Inside Passage. Evening gala dinner and enrichment lecture round off the day in Regent style.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage

portsOfCall.description: All excursions included — floatplane tour to Misty Fjords, sportfishing charter, or totem pole exploration. Regent's Ketchikan program offers remarkable flexibility.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through the narrow, dramatic Tracy Arm Fjord — sheer granite walls and the twin Sawyer Glaciers create an otherworldly landscape.
portsOfCall.name: Tracy Arm Fjord

portsOfCall.description: The uncrowded gem of Southeast Alaska. World-class bald eagle viewing at the Chilkat Bald Eagle Preserve and scenic mountain hikes are included in Regent's Haines program.
portsOfCall.name: Haines, AK

portsOfCall.description: A grand final port call in British Columbia's elegant capital. Regent guests have a full day to explore Victoria's heritage gardens and culture before the voyage concludes.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

portsOfCall.description: Final sea day as Seven Seas Explorer completes her 12-night Alaska voyage. Farewell gala dinner and a chance to relive the voyage's extraordinary highlights.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Pacific Coastal

portsOfCall.description: Return to Seattle — disembarkation day. Transfers to airport or hotel are included in your all-inclusive Regent fare.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

reviewSnippet: "Once you sail Regent Seven Seas Explorer, there is truly no going back. Every shore excursion, every restaurant, every bottle of wine — included. Alaska is extraordinary; experiencing it from the world's most luxurious ship is life-changing." — Verified Guest
